textos: 016 · SAN CATALDO · MODENA
In 1971, Aldo Rossi was in a car crash.
016 · 1971 · SLAVONSKI BROD
Lying in a hospital bed, he imagined a cemetery.
016 · 1972 · THE COMPETITION
A year later, he won the competition to extend Modena's cemetery.
016 · «L'AZZURRO DEL CIELO»
He designed it as a city of the dead.
016 · THE CUBE · OSSUARY
At one end, a cube with no roof and no floors.
016 · 63 WINDOWS PER SIDE
An abandoned house: that was how Rossi saw death.
016 · THE CONE · COMMON GRAVE
At the other, a cone over the common grave.
016 · 25 M · NEVER BUILT
It recalled a chimney, and those of the death camps.
More than 50 years later, the cemetery is still unfinished.
Rossi died in 1997, in another car crash.
016 · SAN CATALDO
The cone is still waiting.

portada.t: a cemetery born from a car crash?
